summary: Automates the versioning, building, and publishing process for the npm package via manual workflow trigger.
responsibilities: Increments project version using npm/pnpm commands based on user input
Performs package validation and builds the source
Publishes the package to the public npm registry with provenance
Synchronizes Git commits and tags back to the main branch
